name: Dukesell
long_description:
Duke equips ecommerce merchants with the tools they need to participate in agentic commerce, regardless of platform or geography.

Merchants can deploy voice agents that understand customers, recommend products and help process orders in 50+ languages. Duke connects deeply to the merchant’s catalog, inventory, customer history, orders and fulfillment, giving agents the context they need to personalize and complete transactions.

Duke also provides the agent-ready infrastructure that makes merchant products and purchasing flows accessible to external commerce agents, allowing consumers to discover and buy from merchants through the AI tools they already use.

Merchants can connect an existing Shopify store or use Duke directly. Our goal is to make every merchant discoverable, understandable and transactable by agents.
one_liner: Duke makes every ecommerce merchant agent-ready
